contract_policy: The named behavioral cases are tracked here and implemented with their owner milestone; M1 locks down the baseline and prevents F1-F14 coverage gaps.

findings.target: Across 10 years, no gap over 3 days without a nontrivial event.
Event density is roughly stationary after warmup.
Deaths, sinkings, captures, and ransoms occur at measurable rates.
Births/recruits, deaths, retirements, rookies, and factions turn over.
Strength changes with ship components, crew, supplies, and readiness.
Upsets cite explicit causal factors in structured event data.
Repeated-sequence detector rejects fixed ritual loops.
Repeated offense after reconciliation is worse and can escalate to violence.
Every entity has one consistent location on an island/route graph.
Goods and silver have explicit finite sources, transfers, and sinks.
Names are unique; rendered outputs never leak IDs or self-reference.
One treaty state machine per faction pair; no duplicate alliance transitions.
All non-root event causes resolve to real earlier event IDs.
At least 30 islands, 5–8 factions, hundreds of minor characters, and 8–15 major named figures.
